name: @vessel-agent/model-registry
description: Model registry management — vendors, aliases, encrypted credentials and connectivity tests

vessel.name: Model Registry
vessel.description: 模型管理：厂商 / 别名 / 默认模型注册表 + 加密凭证库 + 连通性测试（管理 API，P1 无 UI 贡献）

rpc.name: list
rpc.description: Registry snapshot: vendors / aliases / default / effective / legacy

rpc.name: vendor_set
rpc.description: Create or replace a vendor entry (whole-entry replace)

rpc.name: vendor_remove
rpc.description: Remove a vendor; refuses while aliases / default reference it

rpc.name: alias_set
rpc.description: Create or replace a flat alias (alias -> vendor/model)

rpc.name: default_set
rpc.description: Set models.default ref; returns the effective model

rpc.name: credential_set
rpc.description: Store or rotate an encrypted credential (value is write-only, never echoed)

rpc.name: credential_remove
rpc.description: Remove a credential; refuses while vendors reference it

rpc.name: credentials_list
rpc.description: Credential metadata only: id / createdAt / updatedAt / usedBy (no values)

rpc.name: test
rpc.description: User-triggered connectivity test against a saved vendor (sends a real minimal request)
